tei:div.tei:p: dag gis/ /yongs su bskor cing gshegs mdzad kyis/ /sdang sems ldan pa rnam byer cig /snying

rje'i bdag nyid can rnams 'khod/ /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ /dgra bcom slob pa'i bden tshig gis/ /'jig rten mi phan byed pa rnams/ /grong khyer 'dir ni stongs gyur cig /sems can kun dang srog chags kun/ /'byung po kun dang khyed cag kun/ /bde ba 'ba' zhig ldan gyur cig(《 zha 》+ thams cad nad rnams med par shog /kun gyi bzang rnams mthong gyur cig )/ gang yang sdig par ma gyur cig /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ / nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod gyur cig /ces brjod du gzhug go /de nas rang gis ku sha la sogs pa'i bum pa'i chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇā ya/ che ge mo'am/ grong khyer pa'am/ rta'i tshogs sam/ phyugs la sogs pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ gdon thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ nad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ rims thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs cho ga dang bcas pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas sbyar ba'o/ /rje btsun ba ri ba las brgyud gsung*// //༄༅/ /lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun ri khrod lo ma can bsgom par 'dod pas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ khyad par du bdag dang gzhan gyi rims dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba zhi bar bya snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ rang gi shes pa pam̐ las rdo rje pam̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas/

sems can gyi don byas/ slar tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mi'u thung shin tu khros pa'i cha lugs can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas dgra sta 'debs pa'i tshul/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub la rdo rje'i zhags pas dkris pa/ gnyis pas 'bras bu sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i shing lo sar pa'i rnga yab 'dzin pa/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ shing lo sar pa'i na bza' mnabs shing*/ me tog dang 'bras bu sna chogs kyis brgyan pa bsgom | de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ snying gi nang gi pam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can ma la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rang la bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs | mchod pa lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag gsang sngags dang rig sngags thams cad la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de la me tog la sogs pas mchod nas | rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i | | lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad dang bgegs/ /kun du zhi mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /de nas rang gi snying ga'i pam̐ gi mtha' ma sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis/ bgegs kyi tshogs nye bar zhi ba dang*/

rims nad thams cad bsal bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇā ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par bskyed pa'i nang du/ lha tshul 'dis bskyed la/ bzlas pa byas pa'i mthar gzhan gyi don bya/ chos rje sa skya pa'i man ngag yi ger bkod pa'o/ /oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇā ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gri h+na pa ya ma ma sa pa ri wā ra sarba ro ga pra sha ma ṇā ya swā hā// //༄༅/ /ri khrod lo ma can gyi bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo | | rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i | | lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs/ /kun du zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing dang yul rnams kun du rnam 'phrul zhing*/ khyad par ri khrod gnas su rnam rol nas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba/ /ri khrod dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs dang*/ /sna tshogs mdog dang sna tshogs cha lugs dang*/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang sna tshogs phyag mtshan gyis/ /rnam par sgeg pa khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyad par gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas/ /me tog 'bras bu du mas rnam spud pa'i/ /shing lo sar pa'i na bzas rab klubs pa/ /lo ma gyon pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi rig sngags zhi ba'i nga ro yis/ /'gro ba'i rims dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*/ /drag po'i gsang sngags 'brug ltar cher bsgrags pas/ /gdug pa 'joms mdzad gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid thugs zhi bas 'gro ba zhi mdzad cing*/ /brtse bas rjes chags dgyes pa chen po yis | | tshe dang dpal 'byor rnam par rgyas mdzad ma/ /rnam grol yangs pa'i thugs mnga' khyed la 'dud/ /sgrub dang bzlas brjod brtson pas nyid kyi thugs | | bskul bas bdag la brtse ba nyer dgongs nas/

/bgegs dang nad sogs sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol | | skye ba kun du bdag gi mgon mdzad de/ /nyam nga'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab pa dang*/ /srid zhi'i bde dga' rgya mtshos rab 'byor cing*/ /rdzogs sangs yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur bar mdzod/ /rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi bstod pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas chu mig dpal gyi bde chen du sbyar ba'o// //oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he dun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ ti ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā// //༄༅/ /bsrung ba lnga'i dbang chog gi skor rnams bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /de nas phyogs kyi gtor ma gtang ba'i phyir/ shar phyogs nas yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /s+yād+ya the dan/ dha ri ṇi dha ri ṇi/ pra san+dha dha ri ṇi/ bhañdza ni pra bhañdza ni/ bi da ma ni kiṃ pu ru ṣe/ sha ka le sā ra ti shu la dha re/ shud+dha tsa ra ni gho ṣa wa ti/ sa ra gra he/ shān+tiṃ che ge mo/ shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*/ /gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur gyur cig /che ge mo shar phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ a khe ma khe/ bi na khe/ ban+dhe/ ba ra dhe/ tsa pa le/ ba khe ba kha ne a khi le/ ba hu le | bha gan dha le/ ba she ba sha ba ti swā hā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi ming dang*/

stobs dang dbang phyug dang byin gyis che ge mo'i gdon thams cad dang | gnod pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swā hā/ lho phyogs nas 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /s+yād+ya the dan/ shān+ti sa ra ti kān+ti/ ka ra ti kiṅka si/ ki ran+ta ki ra ti/ pa ra ḍi dha ra ni/ ar+dhi ni/ bhū mī dha ri ṇi hi ma ba ti dz+yo ti tsa ra ni ba la a gre che ge mo lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /'jig rten skyong dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang | | 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang | | gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyi kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig | che ge mo lho phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas 'di skad kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ kha kha kha me kha la ne kha lo me kha ra li kha ra le/ kha ra khe ka shi ni ka ra te/ ka le ka mī ni bi ma le bi dhe ya sha wa ti sha mi sha ma ni/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po'i ming dang*/ stobs dang dbang phyug dang byin gyis che ge mo'i gdon dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ de nas nub phyogs su mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /s+yād+ya the dan/ ba ra mi ba ra/ a gre ba la ba ti ba li ni/ bi sha be bi ma si/ sā ga re kha ri ka pi le tsan+dha li ba lo ti ri ni/ ni ra dzā ni bi dha ri ṇi ba ra na ba ti a tsa li/ nub phyogs su che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*/

/gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo nub phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ kra ga ye kra ga shekra ga se kru sha me/ kru ke kru ga kha me kru ge a ga le/ na ga le/ sa ma ga le/ ku hu me/ a la ke ka la ke a ra mi re dhi re a ru ga ba ti/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gi ming dang stobs dang dbang phyug dang byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swā hā/ de nas byang phyogs su rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma (《 lu 》+ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye na ma sarba ta thā ga la sogs pas ) phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ s+yād+ya the dan/ khad ga gar+bhe bik+tsak+ṣe/ tsak+ṣa rā dza ne/ tsan+t+re pa ta le bhī ma pa ra pa te/ kha ra a gre bhṛ ku ṭi | ka ra a gre e ka a gre/ brka ba ti sa raṅga ba ti/ tsi ta tra kān+ti che ge mo byang phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ / 'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ / 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*/ / gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig | che ge mo byang phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ sid+dhe su sid+dhe/ a re a ra ṇe | ba le ma hā ba le/ dzam+bhe (《 lu 》+ pra dza bhe ) dza ṭi le/ a kha ne ma kha ne kha kha ne kha raṭ+ṭe/ ha ri pid+ga le/ ti mid+gi le/ ti mid+gi li ni swā hā/ bdag gi sngags kyi tshig rnams grub par gyur cig(《 lu 》+ swā hwā/ ) rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i ming dang stobs dang dbang phyug dang*/

byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swā hā/(《 lu 》+ nas dbus tshangs padang*/ sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas/ oṃ brah+ma ya pra thi wi de wi sa pa wa ran/ ma naḥsarba la sogs pas phul nas/ ) s+yād+ya the dan/ bra h+me bra h+me gho ṣe bra h+me sā re | badz+re badz+re gho ṣe s+thi ri s+thi re sā re a tsa le/ a ra ṇe/ bi sha ne/ rat+na ne/ a ra ne/ ra shū re pa ra a gra pra ba te/ mā ra bha te che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang steng dang 'og rnams su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*/ /bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*/ /gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/ /de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang | | gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang steng dang 'og rnams su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ a saṃ ga khaḍ+ga ba te ba la nir+gho ṣe shū re shū ra dha re/ badz+ra ga me badz+ra dha re staṃ bhe dṛ ḍha sā re bi ra dze bi gha se bā ra gra prā ba te a ra ṇe dharma yuk+te de shi bi ghuṣ+ta/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang byin gyis che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod cing phyogs phyogs nas rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o/ /phyogs kyi gtor ma'o// //gza' dang rgyu skar la mchod cing gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /gza' gang dag rgyu skar rnams kyi khrod na rgyu zhing 'grib pa dang 'phel ba dang bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang*/ lo legs pa dang lo nyes pa dag kyang ston pa rnams 'di lta ste/ gza' nyi ma dang*/ gza' zla ba dang*/ gza' phur bu dang*/ gza' pa wa sangs dang*/

gza' spen pa dang*/ gza' mig dmar dang | gza' lhag pa dang*/ gza' lha min dbang po sgra gcan dang*/ gza' du ba mjug rings so/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ de ltar phyogs phyogs na bdun bdun no/ /skar ma gza' bdun de bzhin te/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhing dka' thub che// nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang*/ /sum cu rtsa bdun tshang ba dag /'char ba dang ni nub pa na | | 'khor lo mtshon cha bzhin du rgyu/ /'jig rten du ni zad 'phel byed/ / gzi che rdzu 'phrul chen po dag /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis su/ /rig sngags rjes su yi rang byos/ /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig rgyu skar gang dag nam mkha' la rgyu zhing snang bar byed pa rnams 'di lta ste/ smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*/ /mgo dang lag dang nam so dang*/ /rgyal gyi bkra shis phun sum tshogs | | de bzhin skag ste bdun pa yin/ /'di ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni | shar gyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag shar phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig mchu ni mi mdza' 'joms pa dang*/ /de bzhin gre dang dbo gnyis dang*/ /me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang*/ /sa ga ste ni bdun pa yin/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni/ lho phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag lho phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig lha mtshams gzi brjid chen mo dang*/ /de bzhin snron dang snrubs dang ni/ /chu stod dang ni chu smad dang*/ /de ltar byi bzhin gro bzhin no/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni nub phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/

gang dag nub phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig mon gru dang ni mon gre dang*/ /de bzhin khrums stod khrums smad dang*/ / nam gru dang ni tha skar dang*/ /bra nye ste ni bdun pa yin/ /de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni byang phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag byang phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig gza' skar gyi gtor ma dang gsol ba gdab pa ste drug pa'o// //de nas sman dang 'bras bus brgyan pa'i dkar gtor gnyis dang*/ dmar gtor lnga bshams nas dkar gtor dang po byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad brjod do/ /rgyal po chen po bzhi'i lam dang*/ lam ma yin pa na gnas pa bzhi yod de de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bkra shis ldan dang*/ kun bshes dang*/ gang po dang*/ dga' ba'i dpal rnams te gang de dag ming shes pa dang

| rus shes pa de la ni rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ me'i 'jigs pa dang*/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ mi'i 'jigs pa dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis ldan dang*/ kun bshes dang*/ gang po dang*/ dga' ba'i dpal la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod nas gtor ma na maḥ sarba ta thā ga tas phul la/ yang 'di skad ces 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la/ bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang | zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shigadakar gtor gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces/ lag na rdo rje'i bu pho lag myur zhes bya ba/ grong khyer khor yug ces bya ba na gnas pa yod de/ gang de'i ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni des srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob par byed/ yongs su 'dzin par byed/ chad pa zlog par byed/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ lag na rdo rje'i bu pho lag myur la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces srin mo chen mo bcu bzhi yod de/ de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa na yang srung srung*/ bltams pa'i tshe na yang srung srung*/ bltams zin pa'i 'og tu srung srung*/ sku 'khrungs pa na yang srung srung ngo*/ /bcu bzhi gang zhe na/

'di lta ste/ stobs ldan dang | dri ma med dang*/ sgra gcan dang*/ rab mnyen dang*/ 'jigs byed ma dang*/ 'dzam bu mgrin dang*/ mchog len dang*/ bla ma dang*/ grags ma dang*/ 'thab dga' ma dang*/ rmad grags dang*/ rtsed mo dga' dang*/ sa 'dzin dang*/ 'thab 'jug go /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin par byed/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces brjod do/ /'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyur cig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces srin mo brgyad yod de/ de dag ni skyes pa dang bud med de dag gnyid log kyang rung ma log kyang rung ste/ gzi brjid 'phrog par byed do/ /de dag gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rwa dang*/ thub med dang | ngan slob dang*/ phra ma can dang*/ bran mo dmar mo dang*/ rab byed dang*/ mig bzangs dang*/ brgyad pa ste 'jigs med do/ /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang | rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa zlog par byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la gsol lo// gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces brjod do/ /'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyur cigayongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/

zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces srin mo bdun yod de/ de dag ni khrag gi dri mnam nas dpag tshad brgyar yang rgyug go /de dag kyang gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ gzi brjid mchog dang*/ dga' brtsegs dang*/ sna tshogs sbyin spong dang*/ bran mo dkar mo bzang dang*/ 'jug 'dod dang*/ grong khyer khor yug dang*/ bdun pa ste ri srung ngo*/ /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa zlog par byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir de dag la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shigayang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ srin po chen po nag mo zhes bya ba bu stong yod pa/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa/ mtshan gcig gis dpag tshad khrir phyin pa zhig yod de/ gang de'i ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa zlog par byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so/ / zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang | da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/

chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces/ srin mo chen mo lnga gnod sbyin 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa bdun dang lhan cig tu 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams bsrung zhing skyob par byed de/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rtag tu myos dang*/ rjes su myos dang*/ stobs kyis rgyags dang*/ 'od ma'i sbubs dang*/ lnga pa ste 'byor ldan no/ /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa zlog par byed do/ /de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ srin mo lnga po gnod sbyin 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun dang bcas pa de dag la gsol lo/ /gsol 'debs so | | zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces(《 lu 》+ brjod do/ )/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang | chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā/ bi mu de bit+ti de/ bi tsa ri de bi ka ra ti ka ra ḍi ka ra bī ra swa re/ mu tu ra gho ṣe sha ta ha na na ti/ bi shi ta ghe ag ge na ga ke bi ka tī ke te bi kuṭī ṭī dhe/ bi ra dze bik+ṣu bi te bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod nas rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i gtor ma ste bdun pa'o// //de nas dbang bskur ba'i sngon du byur bsal ba'i phyir skyes pa'am bu med gdugs gcig smyung bar bgyis pa rab tu bkrus pa/ shin tu brgyan pa des dog sa la me tog gi sil ma bkram ste spos sna tshogs kyis bdugs la/ seng ldeng dang rgya shug rigs gnyis kyi zhugs bus la/ sa bon thams cad phyogs bzhir gtor bar bgyi/

zhugs kyi nang du yang gtor bar bgyi/ rtsa ba thams cad dang me tog thams cad tshon skud sna tshogs la brgyus te/ ral gri'am | mdung rtse gsum pa'am/ mdung ngam/ mda' la gdags par bgyi'o/ / spos chab sna tshogs sbyar te bum pa chen po'i nang du blugs la gang la byad kyis phog pa de skud pa des bcings te bum pa'i chus bkru bar bgyi'o/ /skud pa yang tshon gyis bcad de zhugs kyi nang du dor ro/ /stong chen po rab tu 'joms pa'i gzungs 'di yang brjod par bgyi'o/ /gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*/ /tshangs dbang dang ni 'jig rten skyong*/ / gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*/ / 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*/ /de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyis/ /che ge mo yi byad stems las/ /rnam pa thams cad chad gyur cig /ces brjod cing*/ bcings pa'i tshon skud rnams gcad par bya'o/ /de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mes bsreg cing*/ rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang*/ /me yis bud shing bsreg pa dang | | rlung gis sprin ni gtor ba dang*/ /nyi mas nags tshal skems byed pa/ / bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /byad stems las rnams tshig gyur cig / spos dang me tog sna tshogs kyis/ /sdig pa thams cad nges par bsal/ /tad+ya thā | hu me hu me/ ka kha li ka kha li/ kha ra li/ dzu hwi ni/ dza ba le/ ga ra ge ha ra gi(《 lu 》+ ha ra ṇi/ )sha ba ri shān+ti/ pra shān+ti swā hā/ dhā ba ni swā hā/ pra dhā ba ni swā hā/ gan+dha rbe swā hā/ pa laṃ ga ni swā hā/ sarba ka khorda be ta ḍa ts+tshe da ni swā hā/ i mair+yan+t+ra sa dair | ma ma sarba satwa nāñtsa sarba ka khorda be da do ṣa dhi/ man+t+ra bi ṣa pra yo ga sarba dai rbai sh+tshe di tā be di tā dzi tā pa ra dzi ta swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bsreg pa nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa byas nas thal ba lam gyi bzhi mdor dor ro/

/byur gsal ba ste brgyad pa'o// //sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*/ /rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang | | dgra bcom dag gi mthu dag dang*/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang | | shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*/ /maung gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni/ /'od srungs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*/ /kaṇ+ḍi n+ya'i sngar thob dang*/ /kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*/ /tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang | | brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang | | dbang phyug chen po'i stobs dag dang*/ /sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang | | 'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis | | bdag gi dug ni dug med shog /dug med dug rnams 'jig byed shog | s+yād+ya the dan/ he ri ke shi na ki li/ e hi re/ a ma re/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ ka ṭa ke ke yū re/ ha se ha se ha se/ kha se kha se kha se/ kha raṃ ge ga ru ga ṇe swā hā | mu muk+ṣu swā hā/ he le swā hā/ me le swā hā/ 'bras dang rma dang shu ba dang*/ / g.yan pa dang ni 'brum bu dang*/ /lhog pa dang ni g.ya' ba ni/ /bdun pa lags te rab tu bcom/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan chos ni dug mi mnga'/ /chos kyi gzi yis dug bcom mo | | 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste | | bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi mnga'/ /dge 'dun gzi yis dug bcom mo | | sa ni dug gi ma yin te/ /sa ni dug gi pha yang yin/ /chu ni dug gi ma yin te/ /chu ni dug gi pha yang yin/ /me ni dug gi ma yin te/ /me ni dug gi pha yang yin/ /rlung ni dug gi ma yin te/ /rlung ni dug gi pha yang yin/

/bden pa'i bden tshig de dag gis/ /bdag gi dug ni dug med shog /dug ni 'byung ba'i nang du song*/ /gang ba'i snod du dug song shig swā hā/ dug dbyung ba ste dgu pa'o || || na mo bung+nghā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥ su war+ṇ+ṇa a wa bha sa s+yam yū ra rā dzñe/ na mo ma hā ma yū r+yai bid+yā rā dzñai/ tad+ya thā/ sid+dhe su sid+dhe/ mo tsa ni/ mo k+ṣa ni/ muk+te/ bi muk+te/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍe re/ maṅga l+ye | hi ra ṇ+ye gar+bhe/∶rat+na (《 lu 》 rat+ne rat+ne )gar+bhe/ bha dre su bha dre/ sa man+ta bha dre/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ pa ra ma ar+tha sā dha ni/ sarba a nar+tha pra bha ha ni/ sarba maṃ ga l+ye sā dha ni ya sho bha ti/ ma na sī ma hā ma ni sī/ ad+dhū te at+yar+bhū te/ muk+te/ bi muk+te/ mo tsa ni/ mo k+ṣa ni/ a ts+yu te/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ bi ma le/ a mṛ te/ a ma re/ a ma ra ṇi/ brah+me brah+ma swa ra pūr+ṇ+ṇai sūr+ṇ+ṇa ma no ra the/ mri ta sañdzī wa ni shrī bha dre/ tsan+t+re tsan+t+ra pra bhe/ sur+ye sūr+yā kān+te/ bi dhe bha ye/ su war+ṇe/ brah+ma gho ṣe/ brah+ma dzuṣ+ti/ sarba tra a pra ti ha te swā hā*/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag dge ba dang bdag la bsrung ba mdzad du gsol/ bdag lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cigaston brgya mthong bar gyur cig tad+ya thā/ hu tsi gu tsi gu tsi mu tsi swā hā/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /phyir mi 'ong pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo | | bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /tshangs pa'i be con gyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/ /dbang po'i rdo rje'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo/

khyab 'jug gi 'khor dug bcom mo/ /me lha'i me dbal gyi dug bcom mo/ /chu lha'i zhags pas dug bcom mo/ /lha ma yin gyi sgyus dug bcom mo | | klu'i rig sngags kyis ∶dug (《 lu 》 gzi brjid kyis dug nges par )bcom mo/ / drag po'i mdung rtses ∶dug (《 lu 》 gzi brjid kyis dug nges par )bcom mo/ /skems byed kyi mdung thung gis ∶dug (《 lu 》 gzi brjid kyis dug nges par )bcom mo/ /rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mos dug ∶bcom mo/ /(《 lu 》 - bcom mo// )dug nges par bcom mo/ /dug sa'i nang du song shig bdag dug thams cad dang*/ be'u lta bu'i dug dang*/ ha la ha la'i dug dang*/ nag po brtsegs pa'i dug dang*/ mche ba'i dug dang*/ rtsa ba'i dug dang*/ phye ma'i dug dang*/ lta ba'i dug dang*/ glog gi dug dang*/ sprin gyi dug dang*/ sbrul dang*/ byi ba dang*/ srin bu ki ta dang*/ lu ta dang*/ ka na bha dang*/ sbal pa dang*/ sbrang bu dang*/ bung ba dang*/ ba ta ri dang | tre ma bu ka dang*/ tre la ta'i dug dang*/ mi'i dug dang*/ sdig pa'i dug dang | mi ma yin pa'i dug dang*/ dogs pa'i dug dang*/ sman gyi dug dang*/ rig sngags kyi las bde legs su gyur cig dug thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ dug dbyung ba gnyis pa ste bcu pa'o// //sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las so/ / dge 'dun mu stegs byed las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba las ni rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rab tu rgyal

skyi bung zhes byed pa med pa'o/ /zhes yang dag par smra bas smra ba ni/ dus su yang dag par smra bas smra ba yin te/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis tshul khrims dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ dka' thub dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa la gnas pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag gi nang na ni/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bde legs su gyur cig gnas brtan rgyal po'i bu thu bo dang 'dra ba rab tu byung nas ring du lon pa tshangs par spyod pa mngon par spyad pa rnams kyi mchog 'di lta ste/ dge slong kun shes kauṇ+ḍi n+ya dang*/ 'dod pa nyung ba dang*/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan la gnas pa dang*/ chog shes pa rnams kyi mchog 'od srungs chen po dang*/ shes rab che ba dang*/ spobs pa che ba rnams kyi mchog sha ra dwa ti'i bu dang*/ rdzu 'phrul che ba dang mthu che ba rnams kyi mchog maung gal gyi bu chen po dang*/ lha'i mig dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog ma 'gags pa dang*/ mang du thos pa rnams kyi mchog kun dga' bo dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams kyi mchog nye ba 'khor dang*/ chos smra ba rnams kyi mchog byams ma'i bu gang po dang*/ bslab pa la gus pa rnams kyi mchog sgra gcan 'dzin dang*/ mal cha dang stan bsko ba rnams kyi mchog gyad bu nor dang*/ seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa rnams kyi mchog ba ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len dang*/ khyim bdag dang dad pa bskyed pa rnams kyi mchog nag po chen po 'char ka dang*/ lha dang mis mchod pa rnams kyi mchog legs mthong gi bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o/ /rgyal po'am/ chom rkun nam/

me'am/ chu'am/ dgra'am/ mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro'am/ lam log par 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am | ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las bsrung bar bya'o/ /bden pa dang | bden pa'i tshig gang gis sems can rkang pa med pa'am/ rkang gnyis pa'am | rkang pa bzhi pa'am/ rkang mangs sam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes med pa'am/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang | zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o/ / bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'dus byas sam/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ste | bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar bya'o | | yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs gzung ba dang/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par bya'o/ /bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs sam/ 'dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des/ rgyal khams sam/ yul 'khor ram | grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/ khyim mam/ nags sam/ zhing ngam/ nad pa 'di la bsrung bar bya'o/ /yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshams gcad par bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o// gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o/ /bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngas 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/

gti mug zad par bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang | brjod pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden ba'i tshig des ming 'di zhes bya ba'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig med par gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ bden pa'i stobs kyis bsrung ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o/ /nad pa'i zas dang*/ skom dang*/ sman rnams kyang rig sngags 'dis btab ste stsal bar bgyi'o | | rdzogs sangs rnam par sangs rgyas tshe/ /'jig rten skyong bas phyogs bzhi nas/ /snod bzhi dag ni blangs nas su/ /bde bar gshegs la phul ba dang | | mthu yis gcig tu sprul mdzad pa/ /lha yi snod mchog de dang ni/ / bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams/ /ston pa'i phyag na bsnams gyur pa/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /de bzhin lha mo 'phrog ma yis/ /lha rdzas dge ba a ru ra/ /blangs nas ston la rab phul ba | | bdud rtsi 'dra ba'i sman gyi rnams/ /bden pa'i tshig ni de dag gis/ /nad pa rnams kyi nad sel cing*/ /nyes pa thams cad 'phrog byed pa/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*// gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*/ /thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*// log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*/ /gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*/ /'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /shākya seng ge'i mthu rnams kyis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /nad par shar phyogs kha bstan la/ /sman rnams nye bar stsal bar bgyi/ /de yi tshe na rig sngags 'di/ /lag mthil bzhag ste bklag par bgyi/ /s+yād+ya the dan/ kha ṭe kha ṭe/ kha ṭa bi kha ṭe/ tsa le bi tsa le/ bi laṃ be/ ba le ba la ba te/ tsan+t+re/ tsa ra ṇe/ a mṛ ta ni r+gho ṣe swā hā/ rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur/ /bad kan las gyur 'dus las gyur/ /nad rnams thams cad rab bcom ste/

/bdag la rtag tu bde legs shog /bram ze rnams kyis bslus nas su/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa la/ /dpal sbas kyis ni dug can gyi// bsod snyoms dag ni phul ba dang*/ /de las de ni blangs nas su/ /ston pas dug ni bsad nas gsol/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di yis su/ /zas ni bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rnam par gzigs dang lha gang dang*/ /gtsug tor can dang kun skyob dang*/ /log par dad pa sel ba dang*/ /stobs chen lha gang dad pa dang*/ /gser dang dpal ldan 'od srungs dang*/ /shākya yi ni seng ge la// rab dad lha yi dbang po dang*/ /tshangs dbang sum cu'i dbang phyug dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dag dang*/ /nor bu bzang dang dbang phyug che/ /srin mo nag mo chen mo dang*/ /de bzhin gdol mo gtum mo dag /me tog dang ni bdug pa dang | | bdag gi sbyin sreg 'di bzhes shig /de dag tshim zhing mchod gyur nas | | bdag gi kha zas byang bar mdzod/ /zas lnga dag dang 'dres pa yang*/ / bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol/ kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang*/ /zas de kun ni bza' bar bgyi/ /sa bon dag gi tshogs kun la/ /sa yi bcud ni zhugs pa yi/ kha zas 'dres pa thams cad kyang*/ /bdag la ma 'dres mdzad du gsol | | ji ltar skud pa bcad bsregs kyang*/ /de ltar bur yang slar 'byor pa | | de ltar zas rnams 'dres pa yang*/ /ma 'dres par ni bdag la mdzod*/ / s+yād+ya the dan/ kha kha me/ kha kha/ kha kha/ khu me/ shi shi me/ shi hu me/ shi ma shi me/ swasti | swasti/ swasti/ swasti/ ma ma shān+ti/ shān+ta/ sha ra gri/ kha zas lnga dang 'dres pa yang | | ji ltar ma 'dres zas bzhin du/ /bdag gis ji ltar skud bsregs pa// de 'dra'i bden pa mdzad du gsol/ /s+yād+ya the dan/ ka la le/ ka la le/ ka la le | khu khu me/ ag+ni/ saṃ gra ma ni swā hā/ sangs rgyas rnam par gzigs dang sangs rgyas gtsug gtor can/ /bde gshegs kun skyobs sangs rgyas log par dad sel dang*/ /gser thub 'od srungs shākya thub pa gau tamya(《

lu 》+ ma )/ / bsnyengs pa mi mnga' ba la skyabs su mchi bar bgyi/ /mi mchog bdun po de dag g-i ni sku rnams la/ /me tog dag dang spos rnams kyis ni mchod par bgyi// lus dang yid kyang rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis ni/ /de dag rnams la skyabs su nye bar mchi bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul che dang ldan pa de dag la/ /lha gang mngon par rab tu dang ba yod pa yi/ /lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' 'gyur nas/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol/ /'jig rten 'di'am yang na 'das pa dang*/ /mtho ris dag na rin chen mchog yod pa'ang | | de bzhin gshegs pa lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /mi yi mchog dang 'dir ni mtshungs pa med/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /zad pa chags bral bdud rtsi 'dus ma byas/ / shes pas shākya thub de rab tu phye/ /bdud rtsi zhi ba 'dus byas ma yin pa/ /chos de dang ni mtshungs pa gang yang med/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs | | bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /mchog tu gang 'dod tshul bzhin rab bstan pa/ /ston pa'i rnal 'byor bla med rtag bsgrub pa/ /rdo rje lta bu'i mi gnyis lam mthong ba/ /ting 'dzin de dang mnyam pa yod ma yin/ /de bas 'dir ni rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /gang zag chen po brgyad po rab bsngags shing*/ /gang zag zung bzhir brjod pa de dag ni/ /drang srong chen po gang zag mtshungs med pa/ /bde bar gshegs pas sbyin pa'i gnas zhes gsungs/ /de la byin na 'bras bu cher 'byung ste/ /zhing rab gshin la sa bon btab pa bzhin/ /'di ni dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs*/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog / gang dag brtan pa'i yid kyis rab brtson zhing*/ /gau ta ∶mya'i (《 lu 》 ma'i ) bstan la 'jug byed pa/ /de dag thob nas bdud rtsi 'jug thob ste/

/mun pa bsal nas mya ngan 'das thob pa/ /de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs | | bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /lta ba 'di la sbyar ma thag tu ni/ /'jig tshogs lta dang tshul khrims brtul zhugs dang*/ /the tshom dang ni nyon mongs gsum po dag /cig car spangs te 'phags pa'i bden mthong ba | | des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni mchog thob shog /lus sam ngag gam 'on te yid kyis kyang*/ /sdig pa rnam gsum nam yang mi byed la/ /glo bur byas na'ang 'chab par mi byed cing*/ /de ltar de dag lta bas 'dzin mi byed/ /de bas dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs | | bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /ji ltar dbang po'i sdong po sar gtsugs pa/ /phyogs bzhi'i rlung rnams kyis ni mi g.yo ltar/ / 'phags pa'i lam gyi dam pa mthong ba yi/ /gang zag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de bzhin no/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /shes rab zab mos shin tu bstan pa yis/ / 'phags pa'i bden pa su dag rnam bsgom zhing*/ /lus kyang sbyin par yid la byas pa ni/ /de dag 'jigs pa brgyad dang 'phrad mi 'gyur/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog | ji ltar me ni rlung gis rab gtor ba/ /lag tu blangs te bgrang du med pa nyid/ /de ltar kun du sbyor ba rab btang ba/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams bstan du med par 'gro/ /des na dge 'dun rin chen mchog tu gsungs/ /bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ / de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /ston mchog lha dang mi yis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/

/chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khod kyang rung*/ /skye rgu rnams la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang (《 lu 》 la )spyod gyur cig /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /shin tu bden pa gsungs shing brdzun med pa | | bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig swā hā/ shis pa brjod pa ste bco lnga pa'o// //༄༅/ /a rog che la gnang ba'i bkra shis bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ rnam 'dren bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog dang*/ / lha mchog rnams dang sngags dang grub pa'i rdzongs/ /bkra shis yid 'ong 'byung gnas thams cad kyi/ /bkra shis dam pa khyed la sbyin gyur cig /shar gyi phyogs su nyon mongs kun bskyod pa'i/ /zhing du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rjes spyod kyi

| | 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis/ /rgyal sras 'khor bcas shar du bde legs shog /lho phyogs mun pa bcom pa sems bskyed pa/ / yid mdzad bsnyengs bral mngon 'phags rgyal po ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis/ /rgyal sras 'khor bcas lho ru bde legs shog/nub kyi phyogs kyi 'jig rten yul phebs par/ /thub pa 'khon dang rgyags pa rnam gnon ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis/ /rgyal sras 'khor bcas nub tu bde legs shog /byang phyogs sangs rgyas spobs pa can zhes byar/ /bde gshegs rin chen gzugs bkod 'od gnon ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis/ /rgyal sras 'khor bcas byang du bde legs shog /byang shar bdud kyi sde bcom zhes bya bar/ /bdud dang yid gnyis kun 'joms rnam gnon pa/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis/ /rgyal sras byang shar phyogs su bde legs shog /shar lho rtag tu snang ba'i 'jig rten du/ /dang po sems bskyed phyir mi ldog pa yi/ /'khor lo 'byung dpal 'khor bcas bkra shis kyis/ /rgyal sras shar lho phyogs su bde legs shog /lho nub gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa ru/ /bde gshegs rin chen gdugs 'phags snang ba ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis | | rgyal sras 'khor bcas lho nub bde legs shog /nub byang yongs dag rab gnas mngon 'phags par/ /bcom ldan byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba ni | | 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis/ /rgyal sras 'khor bcas nub byang bde legs shog /steng phyogs dmigs med yid la byed par ni | | skrag med mun bral ting 'dzin mngon 'phags rgyal/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis/ /rgyal sras 'khor bcas kun du bde legs shog | 'og phyogs yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa ru/ /dang po sems bskyed the tshom gcod mdzad pa/

/nyon mongs bskyod pa 'khor bcas bkra shis kyis/ / rgyal sras 'khor bcas kun du bde legs shog /dbus kyi zhing khams mi mjed 'di nyid du/ /ston pa skyob pa shākya thub pa ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bkra shis phun tshogs kyis/ /rgyal sras gnas dus kun du bde legs shog/de ltar bkra shis phun tshogs thams cad kyis/ /shis pas rgyal bu khyod la shis bya'i phyir/ /dge slong 'phags pa zhes byas nyer bsdebs nas/ /rgyal bu a rog che la phul ba lags/ /me pho byi ba'i lo sar pa bkra shis par bya ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcu mun pa rnam par sel ba'i mdo'i rjes su 'brang ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rnam par spel ba 'di/ shing mo phag gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba tshes nyi shu gcig gi nyin par dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// //oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swā hā// //༄༅/ /rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa'i rnam par bshad pa gsung rab gsal ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa'i rnam par bshad pa gsung rab gsal ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas kun dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yon tan brgya phrag khrag khrig gzi yis rab 'bar zhing*/ /nyes pa'i tshang tshing tshogs kun kun nas bcom gyur nas/ / 'gro ba'i gti mug rab rib rab tu 'phrog byed pa'i/ /kun mkhyen nyi mar mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho chen po'i ngogs// bde blags nyid du rtogs byed chos rgyal gsung*/ /mi dbang rgyal po'i don du bsnyad pa 'di/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang bla ma'i gsung bzhin bshad/ /de la 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams ma lus pa'i snying po dam pa'i gsung gis legs par bsdus te/ bde blag tu nyams su len pa'i tshul ston pa/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di/ bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin du bdag gis ji ltar nus pas bshad par bya'o

| | de la bstan bcos rtsom par 'dod pas/ bdag nyid dam pa'i spyod pa dang mthun pa dang*/ bstan bcos rtsom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin par bya ba dang*/ bdag dang rjes 'jug gi rgyud la bsod nams rgya chen po bskrun par bya ba'i don du ston pa la mchod par brjod pa'i ngag nye bar bkod nas/ 'chad par dam bca' ba ni/ snyan par grags pa'i sgra yis dpal dang ni/ /yon tan rmad byung don gyi dpal mnga' ba/ /sangs rgyas dpal gyi phul la phyag 'tshal nas/ / dbang phyug dam pa'i dpal la 'di gsol lo/ /zhes gsungs te phyag 'tshal zhes khyad par gyi gzhir blangs la/ gang la phyag 'tshal zhe na sangs rgyas la'o/ / sangs rgyas de ji lta bu zhe na dpal gyi phul du byung zhing khyad par du 'phags pa'o | | dpal de ni rnam pa gnyis te/ snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum du grags | | zhes pa'i tshul gyis snyan pa'i grags pa rgya che ba sgra'i dpal mnga' ba'o | | nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la rigs pa dang grol ba'i yon tan ci rigs pa yod kyang*/ snyan pa'i grags pa rgya che ba med do/ /snyan par grags pa rgya che ba sgra tsam ni/ tshangs pa dang dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug la sogs pa la yang yod pa'i phyir/ khyad par du 'phags par mi 'thad do snyam pa'i dogs pa spang ba'i phyir/ yon tan rmad byung zhes gsungs te/ nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa rtsad nas bcad cing*/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i yon tan ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba don gyi dpal ni sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig la mnga'i/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang med na/ 'jig rten pa'i ston pa tshangs pa la sogs pa la lta ci smos/ slob dpon ma ti tsi tras kyang*/ thams cad mkhyen la yon tan kun/ /mnga' la de yang nyams mi mnga'/ /nyes pa bag chags dang bcas pa'ang*/ /skyob pa gcig pu la mi mnga'/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir 'jig rten na che ba'i che bar grags pa de dag gis kyang bstod cing bkur bas na

| snyan pa'i grags pa yang mtha' med pa yin no/ /gang zag gang gis phyag 'tshal zhe na/ bstan bcos mdzad pa po nyid kyis so/ /de lta bu'i yul khyad par du 'phags pa la mchod par brjod nas/ bya ba ci la 'jug ce na/ dbang phyug dam pa'i dpal la gdams pa'i gzhung 'di snyan du gsol ba'o/ /dbang phyug ni rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur ba'i phyir rgyal po'i ming yin la/ de ni rgyal po phal pa la yang brjod pa'i phyir/ de las khyad par 'phags par bstan pa'i phyir/ dam pa zhes gsungs te/ dam pa'i chos kyi dpal mnga' zhing*/ dam pa'i spyod pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /'dis ni chos skyong ba'i rgyal por yang bstan to/ /de ltar mchod par brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyis bshad par dam bca' ba bstan nas de lta bu'i rgyal po de ni yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di nyid kyis yongs su bzung bas sngar yang de nyid kyi zhal snga nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos mang po gsan zhing 'jig rten dang chos kyi tshul la ma rmongs pa'i phyir gzhung 'di gdams pa la dgos pa med do snyam du log par rtog pa dgag pa'i phyir | tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyis bstan bcos 'di'i dgos 'brel gyi ngag bstan te/ gtsug lag gnyis kyi mchid ni snyan rgu zhig khyod kyi thugs su lta yang chud mod kyi/ /sil snyan mkhan gyi glu dang sil snyan ltar/ /snyan ngag mkhan gyis slar yang cis mi gleng*/ /thub pas mtha' yas gdul bya'i don slad du/ / chos kyi phung po bgrang yas gang gsungs pa/ /kun kyang nyams su blang rgyu 'ba' zhig ste/ /de yi tshul yang 'di bzhin mkhyen par mdzod/ /ces gsungs te/ de la tshigs su bcad pa snga mas ni dogs pa la log par rtog pa bsal ba yin te | 'jig rten dang chos kyi gtsug lag gnyis kyi mchid ni snyan rgu zhig khyod kyi thugs su sngar lta yang chud zin mod kyi rtse 'jo tsam gyi don du yang glu dang sil snyan rnams sngar thos zin kyang sil snyan mkhan rnams kyis nyin re zhing sgrogs pa ltar/

snyan ngag mkhan gyis shin tu don che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi tshul snyan ngag gi ngag gis bsnyad nas slar yang ci'i phyir mi gleng ste gleng bar 'os so | | 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgyal po bde spyod la spring pa las kyang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' ni snyan rgu zhig khyod kyi thugs su lta yang chud mod kyi/ / rdo thal las bgyis dgung zla'i 'od kyis kyang*/ /ches dkar nyid du ci ste mi bgyid lags/ /zhes pa dang tshul mthun pa yin no/ /tshigs su bcad pa phyi mas dgos 'brel gyi ngag dngos bstan pa las/ brjod par bya ba ni chos kyi phung po bgrang yas gang gsungs pa de thams cad yin no/ /dgos pa ni de'i tshul 'di bzhin mkhyen zhing nyams su blang bgyir shes pa'o/ /dgos pa'i dgos pa ni thub pas mtha' yas gdul bya'i don grub pa bzhin rgyal pos kyang grub par mdzod ces don gyis bstan te/ 'og nas kyang*/ mi dbang khyod kyang de 'drar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /'brel pa ni shugs kyis go ba'i phyir ma gsungs so/ /de la thub pa ni sku dang gsung thugs thub pa thun mong ma yin pa mnga' ba'i phyir sangs rgyas te/ des mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa dang bag la nyal dang mthun par chos kyi phung po bgrang ba las 'das pa gsungs so/ /de la chos ni dharma'i sgra las/ dha/ dha ra ste 'dzin pa/ ma/ ma na ste yid 'dzin pa'i don yin la/ kun rdzob tu chos thams cad rang rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin la/ rnam par brtags na chos gang la yang mtshan nyid med pas de'i don la yid gzung bas 'khor ba las 'dzin par nus pa'i phyir ro/ /phung po ni skan+dha ste/ yi ge dang ming dang tshig bsags shing tshogs pa'i phyir ro/ /chos kyi phung po de brgyad khrir gsungs pa ma yin nam/ ci'i phyir bgrang ba las 'das she na/ brgyad khrir gsungs pa ni kun dga' bos thos pa rnams la tshad byas pa yin gyi/ mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya'i khams dang mos pa dang bag la nyal dang mthun par gsungs pa'i chos kyi phung po la sus tshad gzung bar nus/

mdo ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las kyang*/ su zhig sangs rgyas chos la tshad 'dzin pa/ /mi de'i sems ni shin tu myos par 'gyur/ /tshad las 'das pa la ni tshad gzung med | | 'dren pa yon tan thams cad bsam mi khyab/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar bgrang ba las 'das pa'i chos kyi phung po de thams cad thos pa dang rtsod pa dang ngan g.yo la sogs pa lhur len pa ma yin gyi/ sgrub pa nyams su blangs bgyir 'ba' zhig lhur len pa yin te/ thams cad kyang phan pa dang bde ba 'ba' zhig ston pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang slob dpon ma ti tsi tras/ phan pa gsung zhing phan pa mdzad/ khyod kyi bstan pa ci smos te/ /mgo la zhugs ni 'bar bas kyang*/ /ci yi slad du bsgrub mi bgyi/ /zhes gsungs la/ rnam 'grel las kyang*/ skyob pa nyid gzigs lam gsungs pa/ /'bras med phyir na brdzun mi gsung*/ /thugs brtse ldan phyir rtsom kun yang*/ /gzhan gyi don du sbyor bar byed | | ces mkhyen pa mnga' bas brdzun mi gsungs la/ brtse ba mnga' bas phan pa gsung bar sgrub bo/ /de ltar na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sde snod kyang byang chub sems dpas nyams su blang bya yin nam zhe na/ de lta yin te nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi sde snod las ni lus ngag gi nyes spyod sdom pa gtso che bar ston la/ de dang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa mi 'gal zhing bsam pa byang chub sems kyis yongs su bzung bas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro ba yin te/ so so thar pa'i rigs bdun dag /rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom skye yi/ /skal ba yod kyi gzhan du med/ /zhes pa dang | rab tu byung ba'i phyogs dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med dag dang ldan/ /de phyir sdom brtson khyim pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' las khyad 'phags/ /zhes so | | byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ni sems kyi nyes spyod sdom pa gtso che la de dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bslab pa dang mi 'gal la nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu de yang gzhan don rgya chen po mi 'grub pa dang lam dang rnam pa skye med du mi shes pa dang*/

shes bya'i sgrib pa ma spangs pa ched du gnyer ba ma yin gyi/ rang gi don 'grub pa dang*/ gzhi skye med du shes pa dang | nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i 'bras bu yin la de ni byang chub sems dpa'i yang bsgrub bya'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang gdul bya nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can gdul ba'i don du nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam ston dgos la/ de rang gis nyams su ma blangs pa thos pa'i don tsam bshad kyang don du mi 'gyur te/ rnam 'grel las/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom bya'i phyir/ /thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor mdzad/ /thabs byung de rgyu lkog gyur pas/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs la/ rgyal ba'i yum las kyang*/ byang chub sems dpas nyan thos kyi lam shes par bya zhes pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpas rang sangs rgyas kyi lam shes par bya'o zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /gzhan yang 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang slob pa'i dus na chos kyi phung po bgrang yas la bslab pa yin te/ 'bras bu'i dus na chos kyi phung po bgrang yas shes pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i rigs pas kyang grub bo/ /chos kyi phung po mtha' yas pa kun nyams su blang byar 'dug pa la/ tshul ji ltar nyams su len zhe na/ de'i tshul yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshul 'ga' zhig gzhi 'ga' zhig sngon la 'gro zhing*/ mnyam gzhag 'ga' zhig rjes la bya ba/ 'ga' zhig rgyas gdab pa'i tshul gyis nyams su blang bar bya bar mkhyen par mdzod ces pa'o/ /de ltar bstan bcos kyi sngon du 'gro ba bshad nas/ bstan bcos nyid 'chad par byed pa gtso bo dam pa'i chos kyi gdams pa dngos ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul gyi/ dang po gzhi'i tshul du nyams su blang bar bya ba ston pa/ ji ltar 'jigs dang ngo tshas bsdams pa'i mi | | rgyal pos bcas pa'i khrims las mi 'da' bar/ /tshul bzhin gnas pas 'tshe med dpal 'phel zhing*/

/rgyal po las kyang bsngags pa thob pa ltar// zhes pas dpe bstan te dper na rgyal po'i chad pas 'jigs shing*/ skye bo gzhan gyis smad par 'gyur du dogs pa'i ngo tshas bsdams pa'i mi des/ rgyal pos bcas pa'i khrims las mi 'da' bar tshul bzhin du khrims la gnas pas rgyal po'i chad pa la sogs pa'i 'tshe ba med cing*/ nor dang rigs rgyud la sogs pa'i dpal 'phel la/ rgyal po las kyang bsngags pa'i tshig thob par 'gyur na/ blon po la sogs pas bsngags pa lta ci smos te/ de bzhin du/ thub pas dang po'i las can rjes gzung phyir/ /thun mong theg par rnam par bcas pa'i khrims/ /rang gis bsgrub par nus bzhin yul las ni/ /cho ga'i yan lag phun tshogs kyis blangs pa/ /mthong dang ma mthong srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis | | rnam par 'jigs dang pha rol gzigs pa yi/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyi thugs kyis bas 'gyur zhes/ /ngo tshas bsdams te tshul bzhin bsrung bgyis na

| | mthong dang ma mthong srid pa'i bde ba dang*/ /rnam grol yon tan kun gyi gzhir 'gyur la/ /lha dang mi yi mchod pa'i gnas 'gyur zhing*/ /sangs rgyas las kyang bsngags pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs la/ thub pa sangs rgyas kyis dang po'i las can ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin te/ lhas bltas zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyis khams nas/ ral pa can gyi byang chub sems dpa' rab tu mang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'dir lhags te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par bltas te/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor 'di na nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rab tu mang ngo zhes gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na gnas pa rnams ni dar la bab pa byang chub sems dpa' sha stag yin la/ nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di na/ byis pa las dang po pa mang ba'i phyir/ nyan thos kyi 'khor rab tu mang ngo*/ /zhes gsungs so | | dgos pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs can de dag rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ thun mong gi theg pa 'dul ba'i sde snod las rnam par bcas pa'i khrims ni dgag pa dang sgrub pa dang gnang ba ste rjes su bcas pa dang bcas pa'o/ /ngo bo bsnyen gnas dang*/ dge bsnyen dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ dge slong la sogs pa tshul rang gis ji ltar bsgrub par nus pa bzhin du/ yul mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ dge 'dun la sogs pa las cho ga skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ gsol ba dang*/ bzhi'i las la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa las blang bar bya ba yin te/ yang dag par blangs pa brda las byung ba'i tshul khrims yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dul ba mdo las kyang*/ cho ga las 'das na las mi 'chags so zhes gsungs so/ /ji ltar bsgrub par nus pa bzhin len par yang | sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ gang dag bslab pa'i gzhi lnga po dag 'dzin pa dang*/

gang dag bslab pa'i gzhi bcu po dag 'dzin pa dang*/ gang dag bslab pa'i gzhi bzhi brgya po dag 'dzin pa dang*/ khyim gyi nang nas byung ba'i dge slong gang dag bslab pa'i gzhi nyis brgya lnga bcu po dag 'dzin pa dang | dge slong ma dag bslab pa'i gzhi lnga brgya po dag 'dzin pa ste/ zhes pa dang | yang de nyid las/ dad pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag gang dag gis yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas la nye bar gnas te/ lo gcig gam/ zla ba gsum du bslab pa'i gzhi rnams 'dzin zhing zhes gsungs so | | bsgrub par mi nus bzhin du khas cher blangs na nyams nas sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'gyur ba yin te/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ tshul khrims 'chal pa ngan 'gror de 'gro ste/ /de la thos pa mang pos skyob mi nus/ /zhes gsungs so | | rgyu gang gis she na/ mthong ba tshe 'di'i sdug bsngal dang*/ ma mthong ba 'jig rten phyi mar ngan song gsum la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis rnam par 'jigs pa dang*/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sangs rgyas rnams ni mngon sum spyan/ / bstan pa dag kyang srung bar mdzad/ /dus la'ang ye shes ma bsgribs par/ /de phyir btang snyoms mi rung ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las kyang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /kun tu thogs med gzigs par ldan | | de dag rnams kyi spyan sngar ni/ /rtag par bdag ni 'khod do zhes/ / zhes gsungs pas/ pha rol gzigs pa'i 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi thugs kyis bas te/ khrel bar 'gyur ro snyam du ngo tshas dbang po'i sgo bsdams te ji ltar blangs pa tshul bzhin bsrung bar bgyis na/ mthong chos kyi 'bras bu tshe 'di la tshe ring ba dang longs spyod che ba la sogs pa dang*/ ma mthong ba skye ba phyi ma la mtho ris kyi bde ba thob pa yin te/ mdo las/ ji ltar sbrul gdug klu chen nag po yang*/ /tshul khrims ldan pa gnod med gzhan ci smos/ /zhes pa dang*/

'di ni bzang 'gror 'gro ba yi/ /nges pa'i chu lon zam pa yin/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /srid pa'i bde ba thob par ma zad kyi/ zhi ba rnam par grol ba'i yon tan ma lus pa'i gzhir yang 'gyur te/ gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i sems gnong 'gyod med cing rnal du phebs pa las zhi gnas ting nge 'dzin skye zhing*/ zhi gnas las lhag mthong shes rab skye la/ lhag mthong gis nyon mongs pa spong bar byed do/ /nyon mongs pa spangs pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung ste/ de nyid kyis 'ching ba mtha' dag las rnam par grol ba thob pa yin no/ /de ltar yin pa yang slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par spong bar shes gyis la/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ /'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces gsungs so/ /sum brgya pa las kyang*/ nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spong*/ /'jig tshogs lta ba gdon gyi rtsa ba 'joms/ /dpal 'byor pa dang me tog mda' can 'joms/ /ces gsungs so/ /lha dang mi'i mchod pa'i gnas su yang 'gyur ba yin te/ slob dpon ma ti tsi tras/ khyod ni nyan thos sred bral zhing*/ /ya mtshan 'dzin pa ched rnams la/ /lha rnams thal sbyor smon bgyid cing*/ /ya mtshan che ba lta bur mchod/ /ces so/ /lha dang mis mchod par yang ma zad de/ /de phyir ston pas tshul khrims rab bsngags bshad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa'i dge slong 'od dang ldan/ /tshul khrims ldan pa grags 'gyur bde ba thob/ /ces pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas las kyang bsngags pa thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar lus ngag gi spyod pa gtso bor ston pa nyan thos kyi sde snod las 'byung ba'i bslab pa la bslab dgos par bstan nas/ sems kyi spyod pa gzhan gyi don gtso bor ston pa byang chub kyi sems la slob dgos par ston pa/ srid gsum 'di dag sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig ste/

/mya ngan 'das pa'ang zhi ba tsam du zad/ /de phyir 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa la/ /smon pa snying rje'i yul du bltas nas des/ /zhes pa 'dis sems bskyed pa'i rgyu dang po bstan te/ mgon po byams pas/ 'gro lnga dag na bde ba med/ /mi gtsang ba la dri zhim med | | ces pa'i tshul gyis 'dod pa dngos su spyod cing sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras gnyis ka la gnas pa'i 'dod khams pa dang*/ 'dod pa la dngos su mi spyod kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la gnas pa'i gzugs khams pa dang*/ gzugs med pa 'di dag sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig yin te/ slob dpon ma ti tsi tras/ khyod kyi chos la mi phyogs pa'i/ /skye bo gti mug gis ldongs pa/ /srid rtse'i bar du song nas kyang*/ /sdug bsngal rab 'byung srid pa sgrub/ /ces so/ /de lta na bde ba dang btang snyoms kyi tshor ba med dam zhe na/ bde ba'i gnas skabs na yang*/ nam zhig 'di dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /snyam du 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang 'dus byas thams cad la mi rtag pas khyab pas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab kyang so so skye bo la ma gsal ba yin te/ 'du byed sdug bsngal spu dang 'dra/ /byis pa rnams ni lag mthil 'dra/ / 'phags pa'i skye bo mig dang 'dra/ /de phyir byis pas mi mthong ngo*/ /zhes so/ / sdug bsngal med pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la yang yod pa'i phyir de'i lam yang bsgrub bya yin nam zhe na/ mya ngan 'das pa'ang sdug bsngal rags pa nye bar zhi ba tsam du zad kyi/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus dang de'i rgyu ma rig pa'i bag chags kyis ma spangs pas na bde ba chen po'i go 'phang ma brnyes pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po'i snying rje'i gnas yin te/ dpal phreng seng ge'i nga ro'i mdo las | bcom ldan 'das dper na len pa'i rkyen can gyi zag pa dang bcas pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung ba'i srid pa gsum 'byung ba de bzhin du/

bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i bag chags kyi sa pa'i rkyen can gyi zag pa med pa'i las kyi rgyu las byung ba'i dgra bcom pa dang rang sangs rgyas dang dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus gsum 'byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma rig pa'i bag chags ni sa gsum po 'di dag tu yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus gsum po 'di dag 'byung ba dang*/ zag pa med pa'i las mngon par sgrub pa'i rkyen lags so/ /zhes rgya cher gsungs la/ mgon po byams pas kyang | cher 'os sems bskyed spangs pa'i skye bo dag /gzhan don sems dang de yi thabs rnyed dang*/ /dgongs chen don dang de nyid mchog mthong bas/ /bde ba de spangs zhi bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na zhi ba de don du mi gnyer zhing*/ snying rje bsgom pa yin te/ byams pas/ snying rjes zin pa'i brtser ldan rnams/ /zhi la'ang yid ni mi gnas na/ /'jig rten bde dang rang srog la/ /chags par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa de ni der bzhugs nas/ /ri dbang mtho steng bzhugs bzhin 'gro la gzigs/ /zhi la mngon dga'i 'gro la'ang thugs brtse na/ /srid la mngon dga'i skye bo gzhan ci smos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i phyir bde ba med cing sdug bsngal ba'i 'khor ba dang sdug bsngal rags pa spangs kyang*/ bde ba chen po'i go 'phang ma thob pa'i zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa la smon pa gang yin pa de thams cad snying rje'i yul du blta bar bya'o/ /sems bskyed pa'i rgyu gnyis pa ston pa/ sdug bsngal med pas sdug bsngal kun sel dang*/ /bde chen brnyes pas bde ba kun stsol ba/ /sangs rgyas kho na yin zhing de yang ni/ /bdag 'dra ba las 'byung zhing de yi thabs/ /bsgrub par nus pa de slad bdag gis kyang*/ / sangs rgyas nges par thob par bya'o zhes/ /don gnyer zhes bya ba 'di yin te/ rang sdug bsngal med pas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun sel ba dang*/

rang bde ba chen po'i go 'phang brnyes nas gzhan la bde ba'i mchog kun stsol ba de ni sangs rgyas kho na yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas bdag gis kyang nges par thob par bya'o zhes don du gnyer bar bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni yul gyi mdun du khas blangs par bstan pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas thob pa la dgos pa che mod kyang*/ bdag 'dra bas bsgrub par mi nus so snyam na sangs rgyas de yang ni bdag 'dra ba las byung zhing de'i thabs lam nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu spangs pa dang*/ rtogs pa phun sum tshogs par bsgrub par nus pa de'i phyir ro// spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs par nus par ma grub ste dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin yin pas spang bar mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/ gal te spang nus kyang spong pa'i thabs mi shes pa'i phyir dang*/ lus kyi dri ma dang 'dra ste spangs kyang slar 'byung ba'i phyir ro zhe na/ ma yin te/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rgyu spang ba'i phyir dang*/ dri ma'i rgyu mi shes pa yin zhing de'i gnyen po shes rab yin la de goms pas spang ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam 'grel las/ rgyu yod phyir dang rgyu yi ni/ /gnyen pos goms pas zad phyir dang*/ /rgyu yi rang bzhin shes pa yis/ /de shes pa yang grub pa yin/ /zhes so/ /rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa yang bsgrub par nus pa yin te/ stong nyid goms pa sems kyi chos min pas/ /goms na mtha' med du 'gyur ba'i phyor ro/ /tshad ma rigs pa'i gter las/ thabs dang shes rab legs sbyangs pas/ /phan tshun rgyu dang rkyen gyur pas/ /ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i/ /ye shes gzigs pa 'grub par 'gyur | | zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar sems can la snying brtse ba dang*/ sangs rgyas la 'dod pa ste rgyu gnyis kyis don du gnyer la sems bskyed par bya'o/ / zhes yongs gcod bsgrub pa'i sgo nas sems bskyed par gsungs nas rnam gcad dgag pa'i sgo nas ston pa/

mi zhum sgyid lug med pa yi/ /g.yo med byang chub sems mchog sgom par bgyi zhes gsungs pa ste/ de ltar 'bad na grol ba tsam bsgrub par nus kyang sangs rgyas bsgrub par mi nus te/ dus bskal pa grangs med pa gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsag dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ sems can grangs med pa'i don bya dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ shes bya mtha' med shes dgos la/ de la chos tshig re'i don du yang stong gsum me lce gcig tu gyur pa las brgal ba la sogs pa'i dka' ba spyad par mi nus so snyam pa ni zhum pa yin la/ de las bzlog ste/ spyod 'jug las/ gal te sems can mir gyur pa/ /tshad med skad cig re re la/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir | | zhum pa dang du blang mi bya/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis kyang*/ nye du 'brel pa 'khor ba'i nang du chud gyur cing*/ /glong gi nang du chud pa lta bur gyur pa la/ /skye shi 'phos pas ngo ma shes pa de bor nas/ /de las bdag nyid gcig thar byed na khrel yod min/ /zhes gsungs la/ sems can grangs med pa'i don bya dgos pa nyid kyis/ tshogs myur du 'dum par 'gyur ba yin te/ sems can mtha' med kyi don byas pas dge ba'i rtsa ba yang mtha' med 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ 'di ni byang chub sems stobs kyis/ /sngon gyi sdig pa zad byed cing*/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rgyu byed phyir/ /nyan thos rnam pas mchog tu bshad/ /ces gsungs so/ / dus bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs sogs pa yang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi don du blos sbyangs pas yun ring ba ma yin te/ lits+tsha byi dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa las/ 'khor ba bsdus pas 'dul ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la ni bskal pa la yang zhag bdun gyi snang ba skye la/ 'khor ba rgyas pas 'dul ba'i byang chub sems dpa' la ni zhag bdun la'ang bskal pa'i snang ba skye zhes so/

/gzhan yang tshogs lam chen po nas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhis rtse zhing*/ sbyor lam nas ngan song du mi ltung*/ mthong lam nas so so'i skye bor mi ldog pa la sogs pa rim gyis yon tan du mas dga' zhing sdug bsngal med pa'i lam la gnas par 'gyur bas yun ring po ci'i phyir skyon yin/ slob dpon zhi ba lhas kyang*/ de bas skyo ngal kun sel ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyi rtar zhon nas/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ /sems shes su zhig sgyid lug byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing na yang*/ mig rnam par dag pas bltas na sems dang po bskyed pa dang*/ spyod pa spyad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i nang nas bdag gcig pu ci ste dman/ spyod 'jug las kyang*/ sbrang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang*/ /de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa/ /des kyang brtson pa'i stobs bskyed na/ /byang chub thob dka' bla med 'thob/ /ces gsungs so/ /chos kyi don du dka' ba spyod pa dang*/ mgo dang rkang lag sbyin pa la sogs pa yang gtong ba dang*/ bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*/ zhes pa thob pa'i spyod pa yin la de yang sa ma thob pa'i gnas skabs kyi zas kham re sbyin pas 'bad pa chung ba yin te/ thog ma med pa nas lus du ma thob kyang*/ byang chub kyi rgyur ma gyur la/ lus 'di ni nges pa kho nar byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur bas/ rnyed pa'i mchog rnyed do snyam du rtogs pa'i phyir ro

| | 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las kyang*/ bdag gis sems can 'di dag yongs su mi gtang*/ bdag gis sems can 'di dag thams cad sdug bsngal gyi phung po dpag tu med pa las bsgral bar bya'o/ /bdag gi lus brgyar gtubs kyang chung ngu na/ bdag gis gnod sems kyang mi bskyed do snyam du/ de ltar byang chub sems dpas sems bskyed par bya'o/ /gal te sems de ltar gnas na dka' ba byed pa'i 'du shes spyod pa ma yin no/ /dka' ba byed pa'i 'du shes su gnas pa ma yin no zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon zhi ba lhas kyang*/ tshod ma la sogs sbyin pa la'ang*/ /'dren pas thog mar sbyor bar mdzad/ /de la goms nas phyi nas ni/ /rim gyis rang gi sha yang gtong*/ /gang tshe rang gi lus la ni/ /tshod sogs lta bu'i blo skyed pa/ /de tshe sha la sogs gtong ba/ /de la dka' ba ci zhig yod/ /ces gsungs so/ /sgyid lug pa ni/ grogs ngan pa dang | sdug bsngal myong ba la sogs pa'i rgyus yid byung zhing lam bsgrub pa'i gegs su gyur pa yin la/ zhi ba lhas/ nya pa zhing pa gdol pa'i rigs dag gis | | rang gi 'tsho ba tsam zhig gnyer bas kyang*/ /grang dang tsha la sogs pa'i gnod bzod na/ /'gro la bde phyir bdag lta cis mi bzod/ /ces pa'i tshul gyis sgyid lug pa med pa ste gong du bstan pa'i srid pa dang zhi ba'i chos kyis g.yo ba med par brtan pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ brtan pa grogs ngan sdug bsngal dang*/ /zab mo thos pas mi g.yos so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /byang chub ni dri ma gdod nas zad pa dang*/ skye ba med pa las de ltar shes pa'i ye shes yin te/ byams pas/ dri ma zad dang mi skye ba'i/ /ye shes byang chub ces brjod do/ /zhes 'byung ngo*/ /byang chub kyi sems de ni sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo las/ byang chub kyi smon pa yang dka' na 'cha' ba lta ci smos/ zhes 'byung bas gnyis yin la/ de las chos kyi rje'i zhal snga nas byang chub thob par bya'o snyam du sems pa ni smon pa'i sems yin la/

de ltar yul gyi mdun du dam 'cha' ba ni smon pa sems bskyed pa'o/ /byang chub kyi spyod pa la 'jug go snyam du sems pa ni 'jug pa'i sems yin la/ yul gyi mdun du dam 'cha' ba ni 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa yin zhes 'byung bar gsung ngo*/ /ngo bo ni gzhan gyi don du byang chub thob par 'dod pa yin te/ byams pas/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ / de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub las mchog tu 'gyur pa'i phyir mchog ces gsungs so/ /de yang sa'i bdag po khyod kyis ma bskyed cing bskyed pa'i don bsgoms par bgyi'o zhes sbyor ro/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las 'byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems nyams su blang byar bshad nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las 'byung ba'i dam tshig kyang nyams su blang byar ston pa/ gang las 'das na dmyal bar bsreg 'gyur zhing | | de bsrungs na ni bde bas bde ba'i 'bras/ /rmad du byung ba 'phral du thob byed pa'i/ /dam tshig blangs nas srog bzhin gces par bsrung*/ /zhes gsungs te/ dam tshig blangs nas bsrung zhes blangs la/ dam tshig gi sgra ni sa ma ya ste/ dus la 'jug la thob pa'i dus nyid nas mi 'da' bar bya'o/ /gang las len zhe na/ bla ma lnga bcu pa las/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ / bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /de nyid bcu la rab tu mkhas/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /rab tu zhi zhing dbang po dul/ /zhes mtshan nyid bcu dang ldan pa'i bla ma las blangs nas/ tshul ji ltar bsrung zhe na/ srog bzhin gces par bsrung ngo*/ /de ltar gces pas srog bzhin bsrung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'phags pa lhas/ mgo bo gcod par nus pa yi/ /rgyal po rgyal srid ster bar nus/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis/

gang las 'das na dmyal ba la sogs pa'i ngan song gsum du skye bar 'gyur zhing | de bsrungs na ni dbang phyug brgyad la sogs pa gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi bde ba'i 'bras bu ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba 'phral du thob par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'phral du zhes bya ba ni skye ba 'di'am bar do'am skye ba bcu drug las mi 'gyangs bar 'bras bu thob par byed pas na/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las khyad par du 'phags par bstan pa yin te/ lo tog smin par byed pa la zla ba drug tu bskyed dgos kyang*/ sngags dang rdzas kyi khyad par gyis nyi ma gcig la smin par byed pa bzhin du sangs rgyas 'grub par byed pa la bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsag dgos kyang*/ thabs khyad par can dang 'brel pas tshe 'di nyid la sogs pa la 'bras bu 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de skad du yang sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba las/ so nam tshul bzhin byas pa yis/ /lo tog rim gyis smin pa ltar/ /pha rol phyin pa'i lam zhugs na/ /grangs med gsum gyis rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i sa bon ni/ /nyi ma gcig gis lo tog smin/ /rdo rje theg pa'i thabs shes na/ / tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /de rnams kyi mjug bsdus te ston pa/ de ltar theg pa gsum gyi sdom pa gsum/ /rang dang gzhan gyi yon tan ma lus pa/ /skye dang gnas dang 'phel ba'i rten lags pas/ /thog ma nyid du brtan par bgyid 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs te gong du bshad pa'i tshul de ltar nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa gsum gyi sdom pa gsum ni bstan pa la 'jug pa'i thog ma nyid du blangs te bstan par bgyid 'tshal lo/ /de la dgos pa ci yod ce na/ de dag ni rang dang gzhan gyi 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan ma lus pa thog mar skye ba'i rten/ bar du gnas pa'i rten/

mthar 'phel ba'i rten lags pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo las/ ji ltar bum pa bzang po rin chen snod/ /de bzhin tshul khrims chos rnams kun gyi gzhi | | zhes pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las kyang*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po stong pa 'di bsgoms pa/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i mgo la de 'dug ste/ /chos rnams rtag tu rang bzhin mnyam 'jog pa/ /byis pa mi rig brtson pas mi shes so/ / zhes gsungs la/ rdo rje rtse mo zhes bya ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa ni/ /dang po'i khrus su bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags mkhyen mdzod/ /ces so/ /gzhi'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa bshad nas/ sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul gyis nyams su blang ba gsum gyi thog ma ston pa | ngag tshig shin tu dri ma med pa dang*/ /tshad ma gnyis kyis kun nas nges pa dang | | mi 'gal ba dang thog mtha' bar dge ba'i/ /chos las chos kyi khyad par nges bgyis nas/ /gsungs pa po de mkhyen rab thogs med dang*/ /dpe mkhyud med par ston phyir brtse ldan dang*/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs kyi nyes spangs pas | | mthu chen brnyes par mkhyen pa sangs rgyas dang*/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dad pa bsgom par bgyi zhes drangs la/ gang la dad par bgyi zhe na/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las | 'jigs shing skrag pa'i mi rnams ni/ /phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang | | kun dga' ra ba'i mchod gnas dang*/ /ljon shing dag la skyabs 'gro ste | | skyabs de gtso bo ma yin no/ /skyabs de mchod 'os ma yin no/ /rten de dag la brten nas ni/ /sdug bsngal kun las thar mi nus/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /skyabs de gtso bor gyur pa yin/

/skyabs de mchod 'os gyur pa yin/ /rten de dag la brten nas ni | | sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ /zhes 'byung la/ slob dpon shān+ti pas kyang | dad pa med pa gtso bo'i dgra/ /lhag dad shin tu gol ba'i gnas/ /gang phyir kun mkhyen tshad ma nyid/ /dad pas kun mkhyen mi 'grub bo/ /zhes gsungs pas yul gyi yon tan shes pa'i sgo nas dus rtag tu rkyen gzhan gyis mi phyed pas brtan pa'i dad pa bsgom par bya ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/ yon tan shes dang sems kyang mi phyed dang*/ /ting 'dzin myur du thob dang 'bras bu myong*// ston la yid ches bya phyir rgyal sras kyis/ /yang dag yongs su smin pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /yon tan de tshul ji ltar bus shes par byed ce na | chos las chos kyi khyad par nges par bgyis pa las so/ /de yang ston pa sangs rgyas byung ba yin te/ des gsungs pa'i gsung rab mthong ba'i phyir ro/ / yi ge'i 'phrin mthong bas spring ba po shes pa bzhin no/ /zhes 'bras bu'i rtags kyis ston pa bsgrubs nas/ ston pa de gzhan las khyad par 'phags par gang gis grub ce na/ dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /legs par brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yis gus phyir min/ /zhes 'byung bas tshig gi khyad par la brtags nas sgrub par byed de/ mkhyen pa mnga' bar bsgrub pa ni/ rjod byed ngag tshig ca co la sogs pa'i dri ma med pa dang*/ brjod bya gzugs gang ci yang rung ba thams cad bstan du yod pa'o zhes pa la sogs pa gzhal bya mngon gyur la mngon sum tshad ma dang mi 'gal zhing*/ des grub pa dang*/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'o zhes pa la sogs pa gzhal bya lkog gyur la rjes dpag tshad ma dang mi 'gal zhing des grub par mthong ba'i phyir dang*/ de lta bu'i chos de thog mar thos pa'i tshe nyon mongs pa sun 'byin pas dge ba dang*/

bar du bsams pa'i tshe nyon mongs pa mgo gnon pas dge ba dang*/ mthar bsgoms pa'i tshe/ nyon mongs pa drungs nas 'byin pas dge ba'i phyir ro/ /de ni slob dpon ma ti tsi tras | re zhig dang por khyod kyi gsung*/ /nyan pa rnams kyi yid 'phrog mdzad/ / de nas yid la bsams bgyis na/ /'dod chags gti mug rnams kyang sel/ / zhes pa dang*/ khyod kyi bka' ni thog ma dang*/ /bar dang mthar yang dge ba ste/ / thos dang sems dang bsgom pa dang*/ /de bsgrub pa la bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid kyis chos dkon mchog kyang ngos bzung ba yin te/ thog mtha' bar dge ba/ zhes pas ni brjod bya 'gog lam gyi chos so/ /lhag ma rkang pa phyed dang gsum gyis rjod byed kyi chos ngos bzung ba'o/ /des na sangs rgyas 'dis shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa yin te/ rjod byed dri ma med la brjod bya tshad mas nges shing dus gsum du dge ba'i chos gsung pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes mkhyen pa mnga' ba ston par bsgrubs pa yin te/ chos rje'i zhal nas kyang*/ gang la shes bya kun gzigs mnga' na de nyid kho bo'i ston pa lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mkhyen pa yod kyang brtse ba med na rang gis shes pa bzhin ston par ma nges pas ston par mi 'ong pas brtse ba mnga' bar ston pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos la dpe mkhyud med par bsam pa dang mthun par ston pa'i phyir thugs rje chen po dang yang ldan pa yin no/ /de skad du yang thob btsun grub rjes/ 'dren pa khyod kyi thugs rje yis/ /gdol pa la yang dam chos gsung*/ /yang dag bshad pa'i snod gyur na/ khyi la'ang smin par bya zhes gsung*/ /zhes gsungs so/ /chos kyi rjes kyang*/ gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba gzigs na de la bdag gus phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar mkhyen pa dang brtse ba gnyis yod kyang mthu chen po med la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis rnam par brdzi bar 'gyur bas/

lta ba ngan pa 'joms pa'i mthu chen po dang yang ldan par nges par bya'o/ /de lta na mgon po byams pas/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub | | gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa/ /mkhyen dang brtse dang nus par ldan | | don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces gsungs pa las/ 'dir gsum las mi gsung ba ni/ gdul bya gzhan gyi don la gsum po 'di tsam kho nas ma chog pa med cing*/ gsum po 'di yod par bstan pas rang gi don brnyes par shugs kyis kyang grub bo/ /de ltar bshad bde ba'i phyir/ dad par bya ba'i yul sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang chos dkon mchog lhan cig bshad nas | dge 'dun dkon mchog 'chad par byed pa/ de yi rjes 'jug phyir dang de nyid dang*/ /rgyu mthun yon tan ldan dang 'dus pa'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi mchog dang spyod yul mthun pa yis/ /zhing gi dam par nges nas dge 'dun dang*/ / zhes bya ba gsungs te/ dge 'dun de ni yongs su 'dzin pa'i khyad par slob dpon thogs med kyis/ bla na med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba nya ba thob pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i lam du zhugs pa dang zhes 'byung ba ltar/ tshangs pa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa'i rjes su 'jug pa ma yin gyi/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i rjes su 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/ yon tan gyi khyad par byams pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul de ni/ /rjes thob de bzhin gshegs rnams dang*/ /sems can yang dag sgrol ba la/ /'jig rten na ni mnyam pa nyid/ /ces pa dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ stobs bcu po yis yongs su gang*/ /mi 'jigs pa yis yang dag ngoms/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas chos/ /spros med rnams la nyams mi mnga'/ /zhes 'byung bas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan stobs dang*/ mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa rjes su mthun pa yod pa'i phyir dang*/ yang na rgyu mthun zhes pas ni/ rgyu ni rigs yin la rigs kyi sgra ni go tra ste/
